text:
Alexa P: quick sync — two customer asks landed: Llama-3-8B (FP16) and a quantized Mistral-7B Q4. Can we estimate ETA, risk, and where to put these on the roadmap?
Mike R: do we have perf/price snapshots for Dedicated vs Hosted for either? that will change prioritization.
Sanjay: we ran Llama-3-8B FP16 on A100 last quarter. rough numbers: 55–70ms/token at 1k seq depending on batch size. Mistral Q4 quant looks ~2x cheaper but we haven't validated instruction-following quality.
Claire: customers specifically call out hallucinations on summarization & knowledge extraction. we should gate catalog entries by eval thresholds + customer beta for Dedicated.
Alexa P: thinking RICE-lite as a quick filter: reach=#customers, impact=product-criticalness, confidence=evidence level, effort=eng+infra. low-effort, high-reach things bubble up.
Eva: I can run our standard eval harness (semantic-qa, summarization ROUGE/F1, instruction-follow). need model artifacts + a runner. will produce delta heatmaps.
Mike R: sequencing idea: onboard Llama-3-8B FP16 first — it's largely FP16 compatibility work and perf tuning. Mistral-Q4 goes behind a quality gate and restricted beta.
Sanjay: FP16 onboarding checklist (brief): model ingest, tokenizer mapping, kernel selection, micro perf sweep, KV cache smoke test. Q4 path adds quant calibration, calibration logs, and expanded eval runs.
Claire: draft launch criteria for catalog entry:
- perf: p50/p95 within 10% of our Redwood baseline on target hw
- quality: <5% relative regression on critical evals
- infra: canary rollout + automated rollback hooks
- availability: customer opt-in beta on Dedicated/Hosted
Eva: canary suggestion: 5% traffic, 48h window, monitor p95 latency, errors, and auto-eval on sampled prompts. set thresholds and runbook for rollback.
Alexa P: private/on-prem note: legal & compliance must sign off before enabling experimental quantized variants. some customers require KMS/HSM binding and audit logs.
Mike R: quick RICE sketch (1–10 scale, rough):
- Llama-3-8B FP16 => Reach=6, Impact=7, Confidence=7, Effort=3 (high priority)
- Mistral-7B Q4 => Reach=3, Impact=5, Confidence=4, Effort=4 (experimental/medium)
We should formalize numbers into the roadmap sheet.
Sanjay: runtime risk: Q4 quant kernels could change KV cache layout. that would impact streaming/continuous-generation clients — need compatibility tests.
Claire: scope negotiation: for Mistral-Q4 beta restrict features to reduce surface area: sync generate + embeddings only, no streaming, no tool-calls, no function-calling initially.
Alexa P: action: draft a minimal rollout spec + owners by EOW. include eval owner, perf/infra owner, docs, legal signoff, and CS comms.
Eva: I'll own evals. Mike = perf + infra. Claire = launch criteria + comms. Sanjay = runtime compatibility and kernel work.
Mike R: I'll start perf runs for Llama-3-8B today and post bench summary + CSV link here.
Sanjay: rough cost estimate to sanity-check (verify post-bench): Hosted per 1M tokens: FP16 ~$160–180, Q4 quant ~$70–90. will confirm.
Alexa P: thanks all. if anyone hits a blocker or a major regression, flag in this thread immediately. default plan: onboard Llama-3-8B FP16 first, then evaluate Mistral-Q4 in a gated beta.
